answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one lantern weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an adversary who spins up 59 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 103 times the capital for one share. The zephyr report exposes the merge explicitly at each summit. A farm of 2694 identities would post 3531 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
